name: Bond

components.pose: She stands with her hair lifted by static before the great dragon, one hand raised and gently resting her palm against its snout, her other hand relaxed at her side, her face turned toward the camera with wonder and quiet certainty; the dragon's head is lowered to her and its eyes are on her; both are fully in frame.
components.jewelry: a {{METAL}} coil collar with {{GEM}} stones, long spark earrings, {{METAL}} armlets
components.effects: A thread of {{MAGIC}} light runs from her palm to the dragon's brow where they touch, the bond forming, motes of light rising between them, small arcs of lightning dancing between them.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Fulgora, an Elder Dragon of electric-gold and arc-white scales, wreathed in crackling static, wings like sheets of storm-cloud laced with lightning, towering close beside her and lowering its great head toward her raised hand, its eyes fixed on her

notes: BOND: the first meeting with her Elder Dragon in its lair, her palm against its snout as the bond forms.
